title: Make the MCP plugin install and setup reproducible
objective: A new developer or agent can install the actual eight-tool client.
outcome: A clean temporary installation initializes, lists tools and exits without depending on the development checkout. Instructions avoid promising native WebMCP in unsupported browsers; the HTTP route remains a tested fallback. Actual MCP stdio JSON-RPC journeys are retained with the exact plugin version; a mocked dispatch function is insufficient final evidence. Marketplace UI installation is not claimed. No tool named in the guide is silently disabled or missing. A successful tool envelope is not a completed research task. HTTP 200 is not acceptance. worker/index.mjs does not import enrichment. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.
